title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exhibition Hall on 1968-12-21
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1968 barn burner with a smoking Alligator and The Other One, captured on an excellent Charlie Miller soundboard despite minor tape hiss.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised as a scorching '68 performance – Alligator, Lovelight, The Other One, Caution and other acid‑drenched gems are highlighted as standout moments. Most reviewers rave about the Charlie Miller soundboard source, noting its crispness and vintage warmth with only slight tape hiss, though one listener found the audio “crappy.” Overall the energy is described as “high” and the drumming especially tight.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.6, overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and sound quality; minor dissent on recording does not outweigh the strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp, acid‑drenched vintage sound with slight tape hiss; a few listeners note occasional muddiness or “crappy” audio but most describe it as clear and well‑balanced.

standout_songs: Bid You Are Standing In My Doorway
show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a fiery opening with Lovelight followed by an Alligator‑driven sequence; the Alligator>Drums>Alligator>Caution flow is repeatedly praised, creating a tight and energetic set.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming highlighted as incredible; Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart’s interplay is described as tightly synchronized and a major driver of the show’s energy.
